text: Supports cloning/interacting with repos over HTTPS, SSH, Git, and HTTP protocols
quote: Working Copy supports https, ssh, git, and http protocols

text: Can turn any folder copied into the Files app location into a new Git repository
quote: Copy directories into the Files app Working Copy location. If the directory does not contain a .git subdirectory at top-level, Working Copy assumes you want a new repository

text: Shows syntax-highlighted source code and previews of HTML/document files
quote: File content is shown with syntax highlighting for sourcecode and a preview of html and document files.

text: Lets you stage and commit file changes from a Changes/Status tab
quote: When you have file modifications the Changes tab lights up... you can commit them to the repository with a button on the Status tab.

text: Can generate AI-suggested commit messages by sending staged diffs to OpenAI
quote: includes the ability to suggest messages using artificial intelligence. These AI suggestions require sending staged differences to OpenAI

text: Repositories can be configured to rebase instead of merge on pull
quote: You can configure repositories to Rebase instead of Merge commits from the Configuration page inside Repository status.

text: Provides a Resolve tool to fix merge conflicts across many files at once
quote: A faster solution is to use the Resolve tool that lets you resolve conflicts for many files at once.

text: SSH keys can be stored in the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID/Touch ID
quote: SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave protected by Face ID or Touch ID.

text: Supports connecting to private/self-hosted GitHub Enterprise, GitLab, and Gitea instances
quote: Working Copy supports private instances of GitHub Enterprise, GitLab and Gitea.

text: Supports regex search of file contents by wrapping the pattern in slashes
quote: Regular expression search is supported for the file scope by wrapping your pattern in slashes such as /[0-9]+/

text: Offers a synced split-view for comparing image changes side by side
quote: Image changes can be viewed in a split-mode where zooming one image will make the other one follow - making it easy to focus on the details.

text: Lets you annotate files with freehand drawing, highlights, and notes
quote: Tap Annotate to draw freehand with Apple Pencil or your finger, or select text to highlight, underline, strike through or add a note.

text: Live preview of files auto-reloads on change while preserving scroll and zoom position
quote: The preview reloads automatically when the file or any local asset it depends on changes, restoring scroll and zoom

text: Can checkout an older commit directly from the commit list
quote: Swipe left on any commit in the repository's commit list to Checkout an old version.

text: Can undo an unpushed commit while keeping its changes in the working directory
quote: For commits not yet pushed to a remote, swipe left to Undo them. The commit's changes remain in your working directory as modified files

text: Can amend the latest commit via a toggle in the commit dialog
quote: To make changes to the latest commit enable Amend at the top of the commit dialog.

text: Can rewrite branch history by deleting, editing the message of, or squashing individual commits
quote: Long tapping commits you can Delete Commit to rewrite the branch without the work contributed by this single commit, Edit Message to change a commit message... or Squash a commit with its child.

text: Provides a Commit Graph view to explore changes across branches
quote: To explore repository changes across branches use the Commit Graph available from the Repository screen.

text: Can create pull requests directly for BitBucket, GitHub, and GitLab repositories
quote: Working Copy supports creating these for BitBucket, GitHub and GitLab.

text: Lets you attach an imported or generated private key to an Identity for authentication
quote: You attach a private key to your Identity which can be imported or generated inside the app.

text: Can view and create Git tags from the Repository status screen
quote: View the list of tags from the Repository status screen creating new tags by tapping + in the upper right corner.

text: Can stash and unstash changes from a repository's context menu
quote: You Stash and Unstash from the context menu of repositories.

text: Supports Git submodules, including other repositories with separate histories
quote: Git submodules allow you to include other Git repositories within your repository, keeping their histories separate.

text: All repositories are accessible via the Files app and third-party apps through document picker/file browser
quote: All repositories in Working Copy can be accessed in the Files app and 3rd party applications using the document picker or file browser components.

text: Supports drag-and-drop of files from Mail, Files app, or other apps into a repository
quote: Drag files from your emails, the Files app or any other supporting app to add to your repositories.

text: Can link an external directory or Document Package from the Files app as a repository
quote: When adding repositories you tap Link external directory and pick a folder or Document Package in the Files app.

text: Includes a built-in WebDAV server for transferring files in and out of the app
quote: a good way to get files into and out of Working Copy is the built-in WebDAV server.

text: Supports automation via the Shortcuts app for moving files and data between actions
quote: Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.

text: Includes a conversational AI Repository Agent that can browse, search, read, modify, commit, pull, and push files
quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
